title: The Days of the Week
label: ch:days
canDo: I can name the days of the week in French and use them in simple plans.

payoff.summary: Seven day-names that are a map of the sky. Five carry a Roman planet-god and all of them carry Latin dies, "day" -- so half of every weekday comes free, and English names the same gods on the same days under Germanic names. Then two days where a later faith wrote over the planets entirely.
payoff.note: Chapter 7 is schema-v2 as of the handwritten-chapter retirement, so the payoff is atom-scored: FR-C07-practice assesses every atom the chapter introduces.
